summary: Playoff Format Dropdown in League Setup Tab - All Tests PASS. The new Playoff Format dropdown was successfully added to the League Structure card in the League Setup tab. All 8 test scenarios verified: dropdown presence, all 3 options available, auto-save with toast, persistence after reload, toggle visibility with playoffs enabled/disabled, and sync with League Structure tab's Playoffs card.
critical_code_review_comments: LeagueSetupTab.tsx lines 81-85: PLAYOFF_FORMATS constant correctly defines all 3 options (h2h_matchup, playoff_tree, condensed_roto) with labels and descriptions
LeagueSetupTab.tsx lines 89-112: playoffFormat state with useEffect hydration from activeLeague.playoff_format and handlePlayoffFormatChange auto-save handler implemented correctly
LeagueSetupTab.tsx lines 346-370: Playoff Format dropdown correctly gated on p.playoffsEnabled, uses data-testid='league-structure-playoff-format', and shows description text below
LeagueSetupTab.tsx line 104: API call uses api.put(`/leagues/${p.activeLeague.id}`, { playoff_format: newFormat }) which matches backend pattern
LeagueSetupTab.tsx line 106: reloadLeague() called after successful save to sync state across components
seed_data_creation: Used existing league: 'Ice Breakers' (Stat Chasers Roto). Restored original value (Condensed Rotisserie) after testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Playoff Format dropdown feature in the League Setup tab's League Structure card is fully implemented and working. The dropdown appears below the team count/divisions/playoff teams row when playoffs are enabled. It auto-saves on change with a success toast. Both dropdowns (League Setup tab and League Structure tab's Playoffs card) write to the same backend field (playoff_format) and stay in sync via reloadLeague().

test_1_dropdown_presence.details: Found dropdown with data-testid='league-structure-playoff-format', current value was 'Condensed Rotisserie'

test_2_all_options_present.details: All 3 options found in dropdown menu

test_3_select_h2h_with_toast.details: Toast message: 'Playoff format set to H2H Matchup'

test_4_persistence_after_reload.description: Reload page and verify H2H Matchup persists

test_5_switch_to_condensed_roto.description: Switch back to Condensed Rotisserie and verify it saves

test_6_playoffs_disabled_hides_dropdown.details: Dropdown removed from DOM when playoffs disabled

test_8_sync_with_league_structure_tab.details: Playoffs card format dropdown showed 'Condensed Rotisserie (roto scoring period)' - both dropdowns in sync

navigation_notes: League Setup tab is the DEFAULT tab when clicking 'League Administration' in sidebar. The League Structure card is the 3rd card on this tab. The new Playoff Format dropdown has data-testid='league-structure-playoff-format'. The League Structure TAB (separate from the card) is accessed by clicking the 'League Structure' horizontal tab.
